<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html {
    height: 100%;
    background: #05060f;
  }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #151c44 0%, #05060f 75%);
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #24306a, 0 12px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 90px rgba(70, 110, 255, 0.18);
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" aria-label="Brick Breaker game"></canvas>
<script>
'use strict';

// ===== Configuration ========================================================
const W = 800, H = 600;                 // logical playfield size
const HUD_H = 44;                       // height of the score bar
const TOP = HUD_H + 2;                  // top wall of the playfield
const MAX_LIVES = 3;
const LEVEL_BONUS = 1000;
const PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 40;
const PADDLE_SPEED = 760;               // keyboard paddle speed (px/s)
const BALL_R = 7;
const SPEED_STEP = 2.5;                 // ball speed gained per brick hit (px/s)
const MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3;         // steepest paddle bounce: 60° off vertical
const BEST_KEY = 'brick-breaker-best';
const FONT = "'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif";
const COLORS = ['#ff5c7a', '#ff9f43', '#ffd84d', '#5ee38b', '#4cc9f0', '#9b8cff'];

// Layout codes: '.' = empty, '1'..'3' = hits needed to break the brick.
const LEVELS = [
  {
    speed: 360, maxSpeed: 560, paddle: 110,
    rowColors: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    layout: [
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
    ],
  },
  {
    speed: 420, maxSpeed: 640, paddle: 100,
    rowColors: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0],
    layout: [
      '....2222....',
      '...211112...',
      '..21111112..',
      '.2113333112.',
      '211333333112',
      '.2113333112.',
      '..21111112..',
      '...211112...',
      '....2222....',
    ],
  },
];

// ===== Canvas & scaling =====================================================
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let sx = 1, sy = 1;                     // logical units -> backing-store pixels

function resize() {
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const scale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min((window.innerWidth - 16) / W, (window.innerHeight - 16) / H));
  const cssW = Math.floor(W * scale), cssH = Math.floor(H * scale);
  canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
  canvas.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
  sx = canvas.width / W;
  sy = canvas.height / H;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ===== Game state ===========================================================
const paddle = { x: 0, y: PADDLE_Y, w: 110, h: PADDLE_H };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: BALL_R, speed: 0 };
let bricks = [], particles = [], floaters = [], trail = [];
let state = 'title';      // title | serve | playing | paused | levelclear | gameover | win
let stateTime = 0;        // seconds since the current state began
let pausedFrom = 'playing';
let score = 0, lives = MAX_LIVES, level = 0;
let best = loadBest(), newBest = false;
let levelIntro = false;   // show "LEVEL N" until the first launch of a level
let ballLost = false;     // show "lives left" until the next launch
let shake = 0;
let toastText = '', toastTime = 0;

function setState(s) {
  state = s;
  stateTime = 0;
  updateCursor();
}

function loadLevel(index) {
  const lvl = LEVELS[index];
  const rows = lvl.layout.length, cols = lvl.layout[0].length;
  const gap = 4, bh = 22;
  const bw = Math.floor((W - 40 - (cols - 1) * gap) / cols);
  const offX = Math.round((W - (cols * bw + (cols - 1) * gap)) / 2);
  const offY = TOP + 34;
  level = index;
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const hits = Number(lvl.layout[r][c]) || 0;
      if (hits > 0) {
        bricks.push({
          x: offX + c * (bw + gap), y: offY + r * (bh + gap), w: bw, h: bh,
          hits, maxHits: hits, color: COLORS[lvl.rowColors[r]], flash: 0,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  paddle.w = lvl.paddle;
  paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
  particles = [];
  floaters = [];
  levelIntro = true;
  ballLost = false;
  resetBall();
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.speed = LEVELS[level].speed;
  ball.vx = 0;
  ball.vy = 0;
  trail = [];
  stickBallToPaddle();
}

function stickBallToPaddle() {
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
}

function newGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = MAX_LIVES;
  newBest = false;
  loadLevel(0);
  setState('serve');
  sfx.start();
}

function launchBall() {
  // Launch toward the held arrow key, otherwise to a random side.
  let dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
  if (dir === 0) dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  const angle = dir * (0.2 + Math.random() * 0.35);
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  levelIntro = false;
  ballLost = false;
  setState('playing');
  sfx.launch();
}

function nextLevel() {
  loadLevel(level + 1);
  setState('serve');
}

function togglePause() {
  if (state === 'paused') {
    setState(pausedFrom);
  } else if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') {
    pausedFrom = state;
    setState('paused');
  } else {
    return;
  }
  sfx.pause();
}

// Space / Enter / click: whatever "continue" means in the current state.
function primaryAction() {
  switch (state) {
    case 'title': newGame(); break;
    case 'serve': launchBall(); break;
    case 'paused': togglePause(); break;
    case 'levelclear': if (stateTime > 0.6) nextLevel(); break;
    case 'gameover':
    case 'win': if (stateTime > 1) newGame(); break;
  }
}

function levelComplete() {
  score += LEVEL_BONUS;
  if (level + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
    setState('levelclear');
    sfx.levelClear();
  } else {
    endGame(true);
  }
}

function loseLife() {
  lives--;
  shake = 0.35;
  if (lives <= 0) {
    lives = 0;
    endGame(false);
  } else {
    sfx.lose();
    resetBall();
    ballLost = true;
    setState('serve');
  }
}

function endGame(won) {
  if (score > best) {
    best = score;
    newBest = true;
    saveBest(best);
  }
  setState(won ? 'win' : 'gameover');
  if (won) sfx.win(); else sfx.gameOver();
}

function loadBest() {
  try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY), 10) || 0; } catch (err) { return 0; }
}

function saveBest(value) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(value)); } catch (err) { /* storage unavailable */ }
}

function showToast(message) {
  toastText = message;
  toastTime = 1.6;
}

// ===== Physics ==============================================================
function movePaddle(dt) {
  const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
  if (dir !== 0) {
    paddle.x += dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt;
    pointerActive = false;
  } else if (pointerActive) {
    paddle.x = pointerX - paddle.w / 2;
  }
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
}

function updateBall(dt) {
  // Sub-step so the ball never moves more than 4px at a time (no tunnelling).
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((ball.speed * dt) / 4));
  const h = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (!stepBall(h)) return;
  }
  trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y });
  if (trail.length > 10) trail.shift();
}

// Moves the ball one sub-step. Returns false once the ball is lost or the level is cleared.
function stepBall(h) {
  const r = ball.r;

  ball.x += ball.vx * h;
  if (ball.x < r) { ball.x = r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx.wall(); }
  else if (ball.x > W - r) { ball.x = W - r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx.wall(); }
  collideBricks(true);

  ball.y += ball.vy * h;
  if (ball.y < TOP + r) { ball.y = TOP + r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); sfx.wall(); }
  collideBricks(false);

  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + r >= paddle.y && ball.y <= paddle.y + paddle.h * 0.75 &&
      ball.x + r >= paddle.x && ball.x - r <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
    bounceOffPaddle();
  }

  if (ball.y - r > H) { loseLife(); return false; }
  if (bricks.length === 0) { levelComplete(); return false; }
  return true;
}

// Resolves overlap with bricks along the axis that just moved. The ball was clear
// of every brick before this move, so pushing it back to the nearest touched edge
// leaves it clear again. Only the most-overlapped brick takes the hit.
function collideBricks(horizontal) {
  const r = ball.r;
  const l = ball.x - r, rt = ball.x + r, t = ball.y - r, btm = ball.y + r;
  const v = horizontal ? ball.vx : ball.vy;
  let target = null, most = 0, edge = v > 0 ? Infinity : -Infinity;
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (rt <= b.x || l >= b.x + b.w || btm <= b.y || t >= b.y + b.h) continue;
    const overlap = (Math.min(rt, b.x + b.w) - Math.max(l, b.x)) *
                    (Math.min(btm, b.y + b.h) - Math.max(t, b.y));
    if (overlap > most) { most = overlap; target = b; }
    if (horizontal) edge = v > 0 ? Math.min(edge, b.x) : Math.max(edge, b.x + b.w);
    else edge = v > 0 ? Math.min(edge, b.y) : Math.max(edge, b.y + b.h);
  }
  if (!target) return;
  if (horizontal) { ball.x = v > 0 ? edge - r : edge + r; ball.vx = -ball.vx; }
  else { ball.y = v > 0 ? edge - r : edge + r; ball.vy = -ball.vy; }
  hitBrick(target);
}

function hitBrick(b) {
  b.hits--;
  b.flash = 1;
  if (b.hits <= 0) {
    bricks.splice(bricks.indexOf(b), 1);
    const points = 50 * b.maxHits;
    score += points;
    burst(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, b.color, 16);
    floaters.push({ text: '+' + points, x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2, life: 0.9 });
    sfx.brick(b.y);
  } else {
    score += 10;
    burst(ball.x, ball.y, '#ffffff', 6);
    sfx.tough();
  }
  ball.speed = Math.min(LEVELS[level].maxSpeed, ball.speed + SPEED_STEP);
  const k = ball.speed / Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
  ball.vx *= k;
  ball.vy *= k;
}

// The further from the paddle centre the ball lands, the sharper it is deflected.
function bounceOffPaddle() {
  const rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2 + ball.r);
  const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, rel)) * MAX_BOUNCE;
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  sfx.paddle();
}

// ===== Effects ==============================================================
function burst(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = 60 + Math.random() * 240;
    const life = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5;
    particles.push({
      x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 80, g: 600,
      life, maxLife: life, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3, color,
    });
  }
}

function updateEffects(dt) {
  if (state === 'win' && particles.length < 260) {
    for (let i = Math.ceil(dt * 120); i > 0; i--) {
      const life = 3 + Math.random();
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * W, y: TOP, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100, vy: 30 + Math.random() * 90, g: 50,
        life, maxLife: life, size: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
        color: COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length)],
      });
    }
  }
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    p.vy += p.g * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
  }
  for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = floaters[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    if (f.life <= 0) { floaters.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    f.y -= 40 * dt;
  }
  for (const b of bricks) b.flash = Math.max(0, b.flash - dt * 5);
}

// ===== Update ===============================================================
function update(dt) {
  stateTime += dt;
  toastTime = Math.max(0, toastTime - dt);
  if (state === 'paused') return;
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
  updateEffects(dt);
  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') movePaddle(dt);
  if (state === 'serve') stickBallToPaddle();
  else if (state === 'playing') updateBall(dt);
  else if (state === 'levelclear' && stateTime > 3) nextLevel();
}

// ===== Rendering ============================================================
const BTN_SOUND = { x: W - 74, y: 8, w: 28, h: 28 };
const BTN_PAUSE = { x: W - 40, y: 8, w: 28, h: 28 };
const stars = Array.from({ length: 90 }, () => ({
  x: Math.random() * W, y: TOP + Math.random() * (H - TOP),
  s: Math.random() < 0.85 ? 1 : 2, p: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
}));
const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0c1233');
bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b0e38');

function text(str, x, y, size, color, align = 'center', weight = '700') {
  ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.textAlign = align;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(str, x, y);
}

function glowText(str, x, y, size, color, glow) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 22 * sx;
  text(str, x, y, size, color, 'center', '900');
  ctx.restore();
}

function blinkText(str, y, size, t) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 5);
  text(str, W / 2, y, size, '#ffffff', 'center', '800');
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function heartPath(cx, cy, size) {
  const s = size / 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + s * 0.85);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s * 1.25, cy + s * 0.05, cx - s * 0.95, cy - s * 1.05, cx, cy - s * 0.4);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s * 0.95, cy - s * 1.05, cx + s * 1.25, cy + s * 0.05, cx, cy + s * 0.85);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function draw(t) {
  ctx.setTransform(sx, 0, 0, sy, 0, 0);
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (const s of stars) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 1.3 + s.p);
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 24, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 24);
  drawBricks();
  drawPaddle();
  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing' || state === 'paused') drawBall();
  ctx.restore();

  drawOverlay(t);
  drawEffects();
  drawHUD();
  drawToast();
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
    if (b.hits >= 2) {
      // Armoured bricks: gold (3 hits left) and steel (2 hits left), one pip per hit.
      ctx.fillStyle = b.hits >= 3 ? '#f2c14e' : '#b8c4dc';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = b.hits >= 3 ? '#9c6f12' : '#5f6c8a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 2);
    if (b.hits >= 2) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 24, 48, 0.6)';
      for (let i = 0; i < b.hits; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(b.x + b.w / 2 + (i - (b.hits - 1) / 2) * 10, b.y + b.h / 2 + 1, 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    if (b.flash > 0) {
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${b.flash * 0.7})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const p = paddle;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, p.y, 0, p.y + p.h);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#a5ecff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#2f7bff');
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80, 190, 255, 0.85)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 16 * sx;
  roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h, p.h / 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)';
  ctx.fillRect(p.x + 10, p.y + 3, p.w - 20, 2);
}

function drawBall() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd8ff';
  for (let i = 0; i < trail.length; i++) {
    const k = (i + 1) / trail.length;
    ctx.globalAlpha = k * 0.3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(trail[i].x, trail[i].y, ball.r * (0.4 + 0.6 * k), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(160, 220, 255, 0.95)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14 * sx;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEffects() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, (p.life / p.maxLife) * 1.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.font = `800 16px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (const f of floaters) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, f.life * 2);
    ctx.strokeText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function hudItem(label, value, x, align) {
  const cy = HUD_H / 2 + 1;
  ctx.font = `700 12px ${FONT}`;
  const lw = ctx.measureText(label).width;
  ctx.font = `800 22px ${FONT}`;
  const total = lw + 8 + ctx.measureText(value).width;
  const x0 = align === 'left' ? x : x - total / 2;
  text(label, x0, cy, 12, '#7f8fc9', 'left', '700');
  text(value, x0 + lw + 8, cy, 22, '#ffffff', 'left', '800');
}

function drawHUD() {
  const cy = HUD_H / 2 + 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0f2b';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#26347a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, 2);

  hudItem('SCORE', String(score), 18, 'left');
  hudItem('LEVEL', `${level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, 'center');

  const r = ball.r;
  const l = ball.x - r, rt = ball.x + r, t = ball.y - r, btm = ball.y + r;
  const v = horizontal ? ball.vx : ball.vy;
  let target = null, most = 0, edge = v > 0 ? Infinity : -Infinity;
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (rt <= b.x || l >= b.x + b.w || btm <= b.y || t >= b.y + b.h) continue;
    const overlap = (Math.min(rt, b.x + b.w) - Math.max(l, b.x)) *
                    (Math.min(btm, b.y + b.h) - Math.max(t, b.y));
    if (overlap > most) { most = overlap; target = b; }
    if (horizontal) edge = v > 0 ? Math.min(edge, b.x) : Math.max(edge, b.x + b.w);
    else edge = v > 0 ? Math.min(edge, b.y) : Math.max(edge, b.y + b.h);
  }
  if (!target) return;
  if (horizontal) { ball.x = v > 0 ? edge - r : edge + r; ball.vx = -ball.vx; }
  else { ball.y = v > 0 ? edge - r : edge + r; ball.vy = -ball.vy; }
  hitBrick(target);
}

function hitBrick(b) {
  b.hits--;
  b.flash = 1;
  if (b.hits <= 0) {
    bricks.splice(bricks.indexOf(b), 1);
    const points = 50 * b.maxHits;
    score += points;
    burst(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, b.color, 16);
    floaters.push({ text: '+' + points, x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2, life: 0.9 });
    sfx.brick(b.y);
  } else {
    score += 10;
    burst(ball.x, ball.y, '#ffffff', 6);
    sfx.tough();
  }
  ball.speed = Math.min(LEVELS[level].maxSpeed, ball.speed + SPEED_STEP);
  const k = ball.speed / Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
  ball.vx *= k;
  ball.vy *= k;
}

// The further from the paddle centre the ball lands, the sharper it is deflected.
function bounceOffPaddle() {
  const rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2 + ball.r);
  const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, rel)) * MAX_BOUNCE;
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  sfx.paddle();
}

// ===== Effects ==============================================================
function burst(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = 60 + Math.random() * 240;
    const life = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5;
    particles.push({
      x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 80, g: 600,
      life, maxLife: life, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3, color,
    });
  }
}

function updateEffects(dt) {
  if (state === 'win' && particles.length < 260) {
    for (let i = Math.ceil(dt * 120); i > 0; i--) {
      const life = 3 + Math.random();
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * W, y: TOP, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100, vy: 30 + Math.random() * 90, g: 50,
        life, maxLife: life, size: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
        color: COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length)],
      });
    }
  }
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    p.vy += p.g * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
  }
  for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = floaters[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    if (f.life <= 0) { floaters.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    f.y -= 40 * dt;
  }
  for (const b of bricks) b.flash = Math.max(0, b.flash - dt * 5);
}

// ===== Update ===============================================================
function update(dt) {
  stateTime += dt;
  toastTime = Math.max(0, toastTime - dt);
  if (state === 'paused') return;
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
  updateEffects(dt);
  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') movePaddle(dt);
  if (state === 'serve') stickBallToPaddle();
  else if (state === 'playing') updateBall(dt);
  else if (state === 'levelclear' && stateTime > 3) nextLevel();
}

// ===== Rendering ============================================================
const BTN_SOUND = { x: W - 74, y: 8, w: 28, h: 28 };
const BTN_PAUSE = { x: W - 40, y: 8, w: 28, h: 28 };
const stars = Array.from({ length: 90 }, () => ({
  x: Math.random() * W, y: TOP + Math.random() * (H - TOP),
  s: Math.random() < 0.85 ? 1 : 2, p: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
}));
const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0c1233');
bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b0e38');

function text(str, x, y, size, color, align = 'center', weight = '700') {
  ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.textAlign = align;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(str, x, y);
}

function glowText(str, x, y, size, color, glow) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 22 * sx;
  text(str, x, y, size, color, 'center', '900');
  ctx.restore();
}

function blinkText(str, y, size, t) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 5);
  text(str, W / 2, y, size, '#ffffff', 'center', '800');
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function heartPath(cx, cy, size) {
  const s = size / 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + s * 0.85);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s * 1.25, cy + s * 0.05, cx - s * 0.95, cy - s * 1.05, cx, cy - s * 0.4);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s * 0.95, cy - s * 1.05, cx + s * 1.25, cy + s * 0.05, cx, cy + s * 0.85);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function draw(t) {
  ctx.setTransform(sx, 0, 0, sy, 0, 0);
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (const s of stars) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 1.3 + s.p);
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 24, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 24);
  drawBricks();
  drawPaddle();
  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing' || state === 'paused') drawBall();
  ctx.restore();

  drawOverlay(t);
  drawEffects();
  drawHUD();
  drawToast();
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
    if (b.hits >= 2) {
      // Armoured bricks: gold (3 hits left) and steel (2 hits left), one pip per hit.
      ctx.fillStyle = b.hits >= 3 ? '#f2c14e' : '#b8c4dc';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = b.hits >= 3 ? '#9c6f12' : '#5f6c8a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 2);
    if (b.hits >= 2) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 24, 48, 0.6)';
      for (let i = 0; i < b.hits; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(b.x + b.w / 2 + (i - (b.hits - 1) / 2) * 10, b.y + b.h / 2 + 1, 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    if (b.flash > 0) {
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${b.flash * 0.7})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const p = paddle;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, p.y, 0, p.y + p.h);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#a5ecff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#2f7bff');
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80, 190, 255, 0.85)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 16 * sx;
  roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h, p.h / 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)';
  ctx.fillRect(p.x + 10, p.y + 3, p.w - 20, 2);
}

function drawBall() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd8ff';
  for (let i = 0; i < trail.length; i++) {
    const k = (i + 1) / trail.length;
    ctx.globalAlpha = k * 0.3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(trail[i].x, trail[i].y, ball.r * (0.4 + 0.6 * k), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(160, 220, 255, 0.95)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14 * sx;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEffects() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, (p.life / p.maxLife) * 1.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.font = `800 16px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (const f of floaters) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, f.life * 2);
    ctx.strokeText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function hudItem(label, value, x, align) {
  const cy = HUD_H / 2 + 1;
  ctx.font = `700 12px ${FONT}`;
  const lw = ctx.measureText(label).width;
  ctx.font = `800 22px ${FONT}`;
  const total = lw + 8 + ctx.measureText(value).width;
  const x0 = align === 'left' ? x : x - total / 2;
  text(label, x0, cy, 12, '#7f8fc9', 'left', '700');
  text(value, x0 + lw + 8, cy, 22, '#ffffff', 'left', '800');
}

function drawHUD() {
  const cy = HUD_H / 2 + 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0f2b';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#26347a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, 2);

  hudItem('SCORE', String(score), 18, 'left');
  hudItem('LEVEL', `${level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, 'center');

  const size = 18, gap = 6;
  const left = W - 92 - (MAX_LIVES * size + (MAX_LIVES - 1) * gap);
  text('LIVES', left - 10, cy, 12, '#7f8fc9', 'right', '700');
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_LIVES; i++) {
    heartPath(left + i * (size + gap) + size / 2, cy, size);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? '#ff4d6d' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13)';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  drawButton(BTN_SOUND, 'sound');
  if (pauseAvailable()) drawButton(BTN_PAUSE, 'pause');
}

function drawButton(r, kind) {
  const x = r.x, y = r.y;
  roundRect(x, y, r.w, r.h, 7);
  ctx.fillStyle = hoverBtn === kind ? '#2a3a80' : '#161f4a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#34458f';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#dfe6ff';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#dfe6ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  if (kind === 'pause') {
    if (state === 'paused') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + 10, y + 7);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 21, y + 14);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 21);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 8, 4, 12);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 15, y + 8, 4, 12);
    }
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 6, y + 11);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 11);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 15, y + 7);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 15, y + 21);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 17);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y + 17);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (muted) {
      ctx.moveTo(x + 18, y + 11); ctx.lineTo(x + 23, y + 17);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 23, y + 11); ctx.lineTo(x + 18, y + 17);
    } else {
      ctx.arc(x + 15, y + 14, 4, -0.9, 0.9);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 15 + 8 * Math.cos(-0.9), y + 14 + 8 * Math.sin(-0.9));
      ctx.arc(x + 15, y + 14, 8, -0.9, 0.9);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
}

function dim(alpha) {
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(4, 6, 20, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.fillRect(0, TOP, W, H - TOP);
}

function panel(x, y, w, h) {
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(18, 26, 66, 0.85)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#33438a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawOverlay(t) {
  if (state === 'title') {
    dim(0.8);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - 260, 0, W / 2 + 260, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#ff5c7a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffd84d');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#4cc9f0');
    glowText('BRICK BREAKER', W / 2, 140, 64, g, 'rgba(255, 160, 90, 0.55)');
    text(`Clear ${LEVELS.length} levels of bricks. You have ${MAX_LIVES} lives.`, W / 2, 196, 18, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    panel(150, 230, 500, 155);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#33438a';
    ctx.fillRect(400, 248, 1, 88);
    text('MOUSE', 275, 260, 13, '#7f8fc9');
    text('Move to steer the paddle', 275, 292, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Click to launch the ball', 275, 320, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('KEYBOARD', 525, 260, 13, '#7f8fc9');
    text('← →  or  A / D  to steer', 525, 292, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Space to launch the ball', 525, 320, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Pause: P / Esc     ·     Sound: M', W / 2, 360, 14, '#9aa6d6', 'center', '500');
    blinkText('Click or press Space to start', 440, 24, t);
    if (best > 0) text(`Best score: ${best}`, W / 2, 488, 16, '#ffd84d', 'center', '600');
  } else if (state === 'serve') {
    if (levelIntro) {
      glowText(`LEVEL ${level + 1}`, W / 2, 380, 44, '#ffffff', 'rgba(90, 160, 255, 0.9)');
    } else if (ballLost) {
      const msg = lives === 1 ? 'Ball lost — last life!' : `Ball lost — ${lives} lives left`;
      text(msg, W / 2, 380, 22, '#ff8a9e', 'center', '700');
    }
    blinkText('Click or press Space to launch', 435, 20, t);
  } else if (state === 'paused') {
    dim(0.65);
    glowText('PAUSED', W / 2, 260, 56, '#ffffff', 'rgba(90, 160, 255, 0.9)');
    text('Press P / Esc or click to resume', W / 2, 320, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
  } else if (state === 'levelclear') {
    dim(0.6);
    glowText(`LEVEL ${level + 1} CLEAR!`, W / 2, 250, 52, '#5ee38b', 'rgba(94, 227, 139, 0.7)');
    text(`+${LEVEL_BONUS} bonus`, W / 2, 305, 22, '#ffd84d', 'center', '700');
    text(`Get ready for level ${level + 2}`, W / 2, 345, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    if (stateTime > 0.6) blinkText('Click or press Space to continue', 420, 18, t);
  } else if (state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') {
    dim(0.78);
    if (state === 'win') {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 180, 0, 240);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#fff3b0');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#f2b233');
      glowText('YOU WIN!', W / 2, 210, 68, g, 'rgba(255, 216, 77, 0.7)');
      text('Both levels cleared!', W / 2, 262, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    } else {
      glowText('GAME OVER', W / 2, 220, 64, '#ff5c7a', 'rgba(255, 92, 122, 0.7)');
    }
    text(`Score: ${score}`, W / 2, 310, 30, '#ffffff', 'center', '800');
    text(newBest ? 'New best score!' : `Best: ${best}`, W / 2, 350, 18, newBest ? '#ffd84d' : '#9aa6d6', 'center', '600');
    if (stateTime > 1) blinkText('Click or press Space to play again', 430, 22, t);
  }
}

function drawToast() {
  if (toastTime <= 0) return;
  ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, toastTime * 3);
  ctx.font = `700 15px ${FONT}`;
  const w = ctx.measureText(toastText).width + 28;
  roundRect(W / 2 - w / 2, TOP + 6, w, 26, 13);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 14, 40, 0.85)';
  ctx.fill();
  text(toastText, W / 2, TOP + 19, 15, '#ffffff', 'center', '700');
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ===== Sound (generated with Web Audio, no files needed) ====================
let audioCtx = null, muted = false;

// Browsers only allow audio after a user gesture, so this runs on key/pointer input.
function initAudio() {
  if (!audioCtx) {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return;
    try { audioCtx = new AC(); } catch (err) { return; }
  }
  if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
    const p = audioCtx.resume();
    if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {});
  }
}

function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo = 0, delay = 0) {
  if (muted || !audioCtx || audioCtx.state !== 'running') return;
  const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime + delay;
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
  if (slideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t0 + dur);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  osc.start(t0);
  osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
}

function melody(notes, step, dur, type, vol) {
  notes.forEach((f, i) => tone(f, dur, type, vol, 0, i * step));
}

const sfx = {
  wall: () => tone(240, 0.04, 'square', 0.025),
  paddle: () => tone(420, 0.07, 'square', 0.045, 520),
  brick: (y) => tone(Math.max(300, 980 - y * 1.6), 0.08, 'square', 0.04),
  tough: () => tone(170, 0.08, 'sawtooth', 0.04, 120),
  launch: () => tone(520, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.08, 880),
  lose: () => tone(330, 0.45, 'sawtooth', 0.05, 70),
  pause: () => tone(600, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.06),
  start: () => melody([523, 784], 0.08, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.08),
  levelClear: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047], 0.11, 0.16, 'square', 0.04),
  gameOver: () => melody([392, 330, 262, 196], 0.2, 0.28, 'triangle', 0.09),
  win: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047, 784, 1047], 0.12, 0.18, 'square', 0.04),
};

function toggleMute() {
  muted = !muted;
  showToast(muted ? 'Sound off' : 'Sound on');
}

// ===== Input ================================================================
const keys = { left: false, right: false };
let pointerX = W / 2;          // pointer x in playfield units
let pointerHover = null;       // last pointer position, for button hover / cursor
let pointerActive = false;     // true while the mouse (or touch) steers the paddle
let lastClientX = null, lastClientY = null;
let hoverBtn = null;

function toLogical(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width),
    y: (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height),
  };
}

function inRect(p, r) {
  return p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y <= r.y + r.h;
}

function pauseAvailable() {
  return state === 'serve' || state === 'playing' || state === 'paused';
}

function buttonAt(p) {
  if (inRect(p, BTN_SOUND)) return 'sound';
  if (pauseAvailable() && inRect(p, BTN_PAUSE)) return 'pause';
  return null;
}

// Hide the cursor over the playfield while playing; show a hand over HUD buttons.
function updateCursor() {
  hoverBtn = pointerHover ? buttonAt(pointerHover) : null;
  let cursor = 'default';
  if (hoverBtn) cursor = 'pointer';
  else if ((state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') && pointerHover && pointerHover.y > TOP) cursor = 'none';
  if (canvas.style.cursor !== cursor) canvas.style.cursor = cursor;
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
  initAudio();
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'ArrowLeft':
    case 'KeyA':
      keys.left = true;
      pointerActive = false;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case 'ArrowRight':
    case 'KeyD':
      keys.right = true;
      pointerActive = false;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case 'Space':
    case 'Enter':
    case 'NumpadEnter':
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!e.repeat) primaryAction();
      break;
    case 'KeyP':
    case 'Escape':
      if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
      break;
    case 'KeyM':
      if (!e.repeat) toggleMute();
      break;
  }
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = false;

}

function drawHUD() {
  const cy = HUD_H / 2 + 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0f2b';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#26347a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, 2);

  hudItem('SCORE', String(score), 18, 'left');
  hudItem('LEVEL', `${level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, 'center');

  const size = 18, gap = 6;
  const left = W - 92 - (MAX_LIVES * size + (MAX_LIVES - 1) * gap);
  text('LIVES', left - 10, cy, 12, '#7f8fc9', 'right', '700');
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_LIVES; i++) {
    heartPath(left + i * (size + gap) + size / 2, cy, size);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? '#ff4d6d' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13)';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  drawButton(BTN_SOUND, 'sound');
  if (pauseAvailable()) drawButton(BTN_PAUSE, 'pause');
}

function drawButton(r, kind) {
  const x = r.x, y = r.y;
  roundRect(x, y, r.w, r.h, 7);
  ctx.fillStyle = hoverBtn === kind ? '#2a3a80' : '#161f4a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#34458f';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#dfe6ff';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#dfe6ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  if (kind === 'pause') {
    if (state === 'paused') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + 10, y + 7);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 21, y + 14);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 21);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 8, 4, 12);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 15, y + 8, 4, 12);
    }
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 6, y + 11);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 11);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 15, y + 7);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 15, y + 21);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 17);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y + 17);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (muted) {
      ctx.moveTo(x + 18, y + 11); ctx.lineTo(x + 23, y + 17);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 23, y + 11); ctx.lineTo(x + 18, y + 17);
    } else {
      ctx.arc(x + 15, y + 14, 4, -0.9, 0.9);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 15 + 8 * Math.cos(-0.9), y + 14 + 8 * Math.sin(-0.9));
      ctx.arc(x + 15, y + 14, 8, -0.9, 0.9);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
}

function dim(alpha) {
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(4, 6, 20, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.fillRect(0, TOP, W, H - TOP);
}

function panel(x, y, w, h) {
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(18, 26, 66, 0.85)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#33438a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawOverlay(t) {
  if (state === 'title') {
    dim(0.8);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - 260, 0, W / 2 + 260, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#ff5c7a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffd84d');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#4cc9f0');
    glowText('BRICK BREAKER', W / 2, 140, 64, g, 'rgba(255, 160, 90, 0.55)');
    text(`Clear ${LEVELS.length} levels of bricks. You have ${MAX_LIVES} lives.`, W / 2, 196, 18, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    panel(150, 230, 500, 155);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#33438a';
    ctx.fillRect(400, 248, 1, 88);
    text('MOUSE', 275, 260, 13, '#7f8fc9');
    text('Move to steer the paddle', 275, 292, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Click to launch the ball', 275, 320, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('KEYBOARD', 525, 260, 13, '#7f8fc9');
    text('← →  or  A / D  to steer', 525, 292, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Space to launch the ball', 525, 320, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Pause: P / Esc     ·     Sound: M', W / 2, 360, 14, '#9aa6d6', 'center', '500');
    blinkText('Click or press Space to start', 440, 24, t);
    if (best > 0) text(`Best score: ${best}`, W / 2, 488, 16, '#ffd84d', 'center', '600');
  } else if (state === 'serve') {
    if (levelIntro) {
      glowText(`LEVEL ${level + 1}`, W / 2, 380, 44, '#ffffff', 'rgba(90, 160, 255, 0.9)');
    } else if (ballLost) {
      const msg = lives === 1 ? 'Ball lost — last life!' : `Ball lost — ${lives} lives left`;
      text(msg, W / 2, 380, 22, '#ff8a9e', 'center', '700');
    }
    blinkText('Click or press Space to launch', 435, 20, t);
  } else if (state === 'paused') {
    dim(0.65);
    glowText('PAUSED', W / 2, 260, 56, '#ffffff', 'rgba(90, 160, 255, 0.9)');
    text('Press P / Esc or click to resume', W / 2, 320, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
  } else if (state === 'levelclear') {
    dim(0.6);
    glowText(`LEVEL ${level + 1} CLEAR!`, W / 2, 250, 52, '#5ee38b', 'rgba(94, 227, 139, 0.7)');
    text(`+${LEVEL_BONUS} bonus`, W / 2, 305, 22, '#ffd84d', 'center', '700');
    text(`Get ready for level ${level + 2}`, W / 2, 345, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    if (stateTime > 0.6) blinkText('Click or press Space to continue', 420, 18, t);
  } else if (state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') {
    dim(0.78);
    if (state === 'win') {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 180, 0, 240);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#fff3b0');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#f2b233');
      glowText('YOU WIN!', W / 2, 210, 68, g, 'rgba(255, 216, 77, 0.7)');
      text('Both levels cleared!', W / 2, 262, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    } else {
      glowText('GAME OVER', W / 2, 220, 64, '#ff5c7a', 'rgba(255, 92, 122, 0.7)');
    }
    text(`Score: ${score}`, W / 2, 310, 30, '#ffffff', 'center', '800');
    text(newBest ? 'New best score!' : `Best: ${best}`, W / 2, 350, 18, newBest ? '#ffd84d' : '#9aa6d6', 'center', '600');
    if (stateTime > 1) blinkText('Click or press Space to play again', 430, 22, t);
  }
}

function drawToast() {
  if (toastTime <= 0) return;
  ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, toastTime * 3);
  ctx.font = `700 15px ${FONT}`;
  const w = ctx.measureText(toastText).width + 28;
  roundRect(W / 2 - w / 2, TOP + 6, w, 26, 13);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 14, 40, 0.85)';
  ctx.fill();
  text(toastText, W / 2, TOP + 19, 15, '#ffffff', 'center', '700');
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ===== Sound (generated with Web Audio, no files needed) ====================
let audioCtx = null, muted = false;

// Browsers only allow audio after a user gesture, so this runs on key/pointer input.
function initAudio() {
  if (!audioCtx) {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return;
    try { audioCtx = new AC(); } catch (err) { return; }
  }
  if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
    const p = audioCtx.resume();
    if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {});
  }
}

function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo = 0, delay = 0) {
  if (muted || !audioCtx || audioCtx.state !== 'running') return;
  const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime + delay;
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
  if (slideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t0 + dur);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  osc.start(t0);
  osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
}

function melody(notes, step, dur, type, vol) {
  notes.forEach((f, i) => tone(f, dur, type, vol, 0, i * step));
}

const sfx = {
  wall: () => tone(240, 0.04, 'square', 0.025),
  paddle: () => tone(420, 0.07, 'square', 0.045, 520),
  brick: (y) => tone(Math.max(300, 980 - y * 1.6), 0.08, 'square', 0.04),
  tough: () => tone(170, 0.08, 'sawtooth', 0.04, 120),
  launch: () => tone(520, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.08, 880),
  lose: () => tone(330, 0.45, 'sawtooth', 0.05, 70),
  pause: () => tone(600, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.06),
  start: () => melody([523, 784], 0.08, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.08),
  levelClear: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047], 0.11, 0.16, 'square', 0.04),
  gameOver: () => melody([392, 330, 262, 196], 0.2, 0.28, 'triangle', 0.09),
  win: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047, 784, 1047], 0.12, 0.18, 'square', 0.04),
};

function toggleMute() {
  muted = !muted;
  showToast(muted ? 'Sound off' : 'Sound on');
}

// ===== Input ================================================================
const keys = { left: false, right: false };
let pointerX = W / 2;          // pointer x in playfield units
let pointerHover = null;       // last pointer position, for button hover / cursor
let pointerActive = false;     // true while the mouse (or touch) steers the paddle
let lastClientX = null, lastClientY = null;
let hoverBtn = null;

function toLogical(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width),
    y: (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height),
  };
}

function inRect(p, r) {
  return p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y <= r.y + r.h;
}

function pauseAvailable() {
  return state === 'serve' || state === 'playing' || state === 'paused';
}

function buttonAt(p) {
  if (inRect(p, BTN_SOUND)) return 'sound';
  if (pauseAvailable() && inRect(p, BTN_PAUSE)) return 'pause';
  return null;
}

// Hide the cursor over the playfield while playing; show a hand over HUD buttons.
function updateCursor() {
  hoverBtn = pointerHover ? buttonAt(pointerHover) : null;
  let cursor = 'default';
  if (hoverBtn) cursor = 'pointer';
  else if ((state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') && pointerHover && pointerHover.y > TOP) cursor = 'none';
  if (canvas.style.cursor !== cursor) canvas.style.cursor = cursor;
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
  initAudio();
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'ArrowLeft':
    case 'KeyA':
      keys.left = true;
      pointerActive = false;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case 'ArrowRight':
    case 'KeyD':
      keys.right = true;
      pointerActive = false;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case 'Space':
    case 'Enter':
    case 'NumpadEnter':
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!e.repeat) primaryAction();
      break;
    case 'KeyP':
    case 'Escape':
      if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
      break;
    case 'KeyM':
      if (!e.repeat) toggleMute();
      break;
  }
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = false;
  if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = false;
});

window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
  keys.left = keys.right = false;
  if (state === 'playing') togglePause();
});

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if (document.hidden && state === 'playing') togglePause();
});

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
  const p = toLogical(e);
  pointerHover = p;
  // Browsers sometimes fire moves without motion; ignore those so the keyboard keeps control.
  if (e.clientX !== lastClientX || e.clientY !== lastClientY) {
    lastClientX = e.clientX;
    lastClientY = e.clientY;
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerActive = true;
  }
  updateCursor();
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
  initAudio();
  const p = toLogical(e);
  pointerHover = p;
  const btn = buttonAt(p);
  if (btn === 'sound') toggleMute();
  else if (btn === 'pause') togglePause();
  else {
    lastClientX = e.clientX;
    lastClientY = e.clientY;
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerActive = true;
    primaryAction();
  }
  updateCursor();
});

// Touch input only unlocks audio on pointerup, so try again there.
window.addEventListener('pointerup', initAudio);
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());

// ===== Main loop ============================================================
let lastTime = 0;

function frame(now) {
  const dt = lastTime ? Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastTime) / 1000)) : 0;
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  draw(now / 1000);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

loadLevel(0);
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html {
    height: 100%;
    background: #05060f;
  }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #151c44 0%, #05060f 75%);
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #24306a, 0 12px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 90px rgba(70, 110, 255, 0.18);
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" aria-label="Brick Breaker game"></canvas>
<script>
'use strict';

// ===== Configuration ========================================================
const W = 800, H = 600;                 // logical playfield size
const HUD_H = 44;                       // height of the score bar
const TOP = HUD_H + 2;                  // top wall of the playfield
const MAX_LIVES = 3;
const LEVEL_BONUS = 1000;
const PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 40;
const PADDLE_SPEED = 760;               // keyboard paddle speed (px/s)
const BALL_R = 7;
const SPEED_STEP = 2.5;                 // ball speed gained per brick hit (px/s)
const MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3;         // steepest paddle bounce: 60° off vertical
const BEST_KEY = 'brick-breaker-best';
const FONT = "'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif";
const COLORS = ['#ff5c7a', '#ff9f43', '#ffd84d', '#5ee38b', '#4cc9f0', '#9b8cff'];

// Layout codes: '.' = empty, '1'..'3' = hits needed to break the brick.
const LEVELS = [
  {
    speed: 360, maxSpeed: 560, paddle: 110,
    rowColors: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    layout: [
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
      '111111111111',
    ],
  },
  {
    speed: 420, maxSpeed: 640, paddle: 100,
    rowColors: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0],
    layout: [
      '....2222....',
      '...211112...',
      '..21111112..',
      '.2113333112.',
      '211333333112',
      '.2113333112.',
      '..21111112..',
      '...211112...',
      '....2222....',
    ],
  },
];

// ===== Canvas & scaling =====================================================
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let sx = 1, sy = 1;                     // logical units -> backing-store pixels

function resize() {
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const scale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min((window.innerWidth - 16) / W, (window.innerHeight - 16) / H));
  const cssW = Math.floor(W * scale), cssH = Math.floor(H * scale);
  canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
  canvas.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
  sx = canvas.width / W;
  sy = canvas.height / H;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ===== Game state ===========================================================
const paddle = { x: 0, y: PADDLE_Y, w: 110, h: PADDLE_H };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: BALL_R, speed: 0 };
let bricks = [], particles = [], floaters = [], trail = [];
let state = 'title';      // title | serve | playing | paused | levelclear | gameover | win
let stateTime = 0;        // seconds since the current state began
let pausedFrom = 'playing';
let score = 0, lives = MAX_LIVES, level = 0;
let best = loadBest(), newBest = false;
let levelIntro = false;   // show "LEVEL N" until the first launch of a level
let ballLost = false;     // show "lives left" until the next launch
let shake = 0;
let toastText = '', toastTime = 0;

function setState(s) {
  state = s;
  stateTime = 0;
  updateCursor();
}

function loadLevel(index) {
  const lvl = LEVELS[index];
  const rows = lvl.layout.length, cols = lvl.layout[0].length;
  const gap = 4, bh = 22;
  const bw = Math.floor((W - 40 - (cols - 1) * gap) / cols);
  const offX = Math.round((W - (cols * bw + (cols - 1) * gap)) / 2);
  const offY = TOP + 34;
  level = index;
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const hits = Number(lvl.layout[r][c]) || 0;
      if (hits > 0) {
        bricks.push({
          x: offX + c * (bw + gap), y: offY + r * (bh + gap), w: bw, h: bh,
          hits, maxHits: hits, color: COLORS[lvl.rowColors[r]], flash: 0,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  paddle.w = lvl.paddle;
  paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
  particles = [];
  floaters = [];
  levelIntro = true;
  ballLost = false;
  resetBall();
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.speed = LEVELS[level].speed;
  ball.vx = 0;
  ball.vy = 0;
  trail = [];
  stickBallToPaddle();
}

function stickBallToPaddle() {
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
}

function newGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = MAX_LIVES;
  newBest = false;
  loadLevel(0);
  setState('serve');
  sfx.start();
}

function launchBall() {
  // Launch toward the held arrow key, otherwise to a random side.
  let dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
  if (dir === 0) dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  const angle = dir * (0.2 + Math.random() * 0.35);
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  levelIntro = false;
  ballLost = false;
  setState('playing');
  sfx.launch();
}

function nextLevel() {
  loadLevel(level + 1);
  setState('serve');
}

function togglePause() {
  if (state === 'paused') {
    setState(pausedFrom);
  } else if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') {
    pausedFrom = state;
    setState('paused');
  } else {
    return;
  }
  sfx.pause();
}

// Space / Enter / click: whatever "continue" means in the current state.
function primaryAction() {
  switch (state) {
    case 'title': newGame(); break;
    case 'serve': launchBall(); break;
    case 'paused': togglePause(); break;
    case 'levelclear': if (stateTime > 0.6) nextLevel(); break;
    case 'gameover':
    case 'win': if (stateTime > 1) newGame(); break;
  }
}

function levelComplete() {
  score += LEVEL_BONUS;
  if (level + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
    setState('levelclear');
    sfx.levelClear();
  } else {
    endGame(true);
  }
}

function loseLife() {
  lives--;
  shake = 0.35;
  if (lives <= 0) {
    lives = 0;
    endGame(false);
  } else {
    sfx.lose();
    resetBall();
    ballLost = true;
    setState('serve');
  }
}

function endGame(won) {
  if (score > best) {
    best = score;
    newBest = true;
    saveBest(best);
  }
  setState(won ? 'win' : 'gameover');
  if (won) sfx.win(); else sfx.gameOver();
}

function loadBest() {
  try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY), 10) || 0; } catch (err) { return 0; }
}

function saveBest(value) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(value)); } catch (err) { /* storage unavailable */ }
}

function showToast(message) {
  toastText = message;
  toastTime = 1.6;
}

// ===== Physics ==============================================================
function movePaddle(dt) {
  const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
  if (dir !== 0) {
    paddle.x += dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt;
    pointerActive = false;
  } else if (pointerActive) {
    paddle.x = pointerX - paddle.w / 2;
  }
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
}

function updateBall(dt) {
  // Sub-step so the ball never moves more than 4px at a time (no tunnelling).
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((ball.speed * dt) / 4));
  const h = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (!stepBall(h)) return;
  }
  trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y });
  if (trail.length > 10) trail.shift();
}

// Moves the ball one sub-step. Returns false once the ball is lost or the level is cleared.
function stepBall(h) {
  const r = ball.r;

  ball.x += ball.vx * h;
  if (ball.x < r) { ball.x = r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx.wall(); }
  else if (ball.x > W - r) { ball.x = W - r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); sfx.wall(); }
  collideBricks(true);

  ball.y += ball.vy * h;
  if (ball.y < TOP + r) { ball.y = TOP + r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); sfx.wall(); }
  collideBricks(false);

  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + r >= paddle.y && ball.y <= paddle.y + paddle.h * 0.75 &&
      ball.x + r >= paddle.x && ball.x - r <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
    bounceOffPaddle();
  }

  if (ball.y - r > H) { loseLife(); return false; }
  if (bricks.length === 0) { levelComplete(); return false; }
  return true;
}

// Resolves overlap with bricks along the axis that just moved. The ball was clear
// of every brick before this move, so pushing it back to the nearest touched edge
// leaves it clear again. Only the most-overlapped brick takes the hit.
function collideBricks(horizontal) {
  const r = ball.r;
  const l = ball.x - r, rt = ball.x + r, t = ball.y - r, btm = ball.y + r;
  const v = horizontal ? ball.vx : ball.vy;
  let target = null, most = 0, edge = v > 0 ? Infinity : -Infinity;
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (rt <= b.x || l >= b.x + b.w || btm <= b.y || t >= b.y + b.h) continue;
    const overlap = (Math.min(rt, b.x + b.w) - Math.max(l, b.x)) *
                    (Math.min(btm, b.y + b.h) - Math.max(t, b.y));
    if (overlap > most) { most = overlap; target = b; }
    if (horizontal) edge = v > 0 ? Math.min(edge, b.x) : Math.max(edge, b.x + b.w);
    else edge = v > 0 ? Math.min(edge, b.y) : Math.max(edge, b.y + b.h);
  }
  if (!target) return;
  if (horizontal) { ball.x = v > 0 ? edge - r : edge + r; ball.vx = -ball.vx; }
  else { ball.y = v > 0 ? edge - r : edge + r; ball.vy = -ball.vy; }
  hitBrick(target);
}

function hitBrick(b) {
  b.hits--;
  b.flash = 1;
  if (b.hits <= 0) {
    bricks.splice(bricks.indexOf(b), 1);
    const points = 50 * b.maxHits;
    score += points;
    burst(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, b.color, 16);
    floaters.push({ text: '+' + points, x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2, life: 0.9 });
    sfx.brick(b.y);
  } else {
    score += 10;
    burst(ball.x, ball.y, '#ffffff', 6);
    sfx.tough();
  }
  ball.speed = Math.min(LEVELS[level].maxSpeed, ball.speed + SPEED_STEP);
  const k = ball.speed / Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
  ball.vx *= k;
  ball.vy *= k;
}

// The further from the paddle centre the ball lands, the sharper it is deflected.
function bounceOffPaddle() {
  const rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2 + ball.r);
  const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, rel)) * MAX_BOUNCE;
  ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  sfx.paddle();
}

// ===== Effects ==============================================================
function burst(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = 60 + Math.random() * 240;
    const life = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5;
    particles.push({
      x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 80, g: 600,
      life, maxLife: life, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3, color,
    });
  }
}

function updateEffects(dt) {
  if (state === 'win' && particles.length < 260) {
    for (let i = Math.ceil(dt * 120); i > 0; i--) {
      const life = 3 + Math.random();
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * W, y: TOP, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100, vy: 30 + Math.random() * 90, g: 50,
        life, maxLife: life, size: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
        color: COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length)],
      });
    }
  }
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    p.vy += p.g * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
  }
  for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = floaters[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    if (f.life <= 0) { floaters.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    f.y -= 40 * dt;
  }
  for (const b of bricks) b.flash = Math.max(0, b.flash - dt * 5);
}

// ===== Update ===============================================================
function update(dt) {
  stateTime += dt;
  toastTime = Math.max(0, toastTime - dt);
  if (state === 'paused') return;
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
  updateEffects(dt);
  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') movePaddle(dt);
  if (state === 'serve') stickBallToPaddle();
  else if (state === 'playing') updateBall(dt);
  else if (state === 'levelclear' && stateTime > 3) nextLevel();
}

// ===== Rendering ============================================================
const BTN_SOUND = { x: W - 74, y: 8, w: 28, h: 28 };
const BTN_PAUSE = { x: W - 40, y: 8, w: 28, h: 28 };
const stars = Array.from({ length: 90 }, () => ({
  x: Math.random() * W, y: TOP + Math.random() * (H - TOP),
  s: Math.random() < 0.85 ? 1 : 2, p: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
}));
const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0c1233');
bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b0e38');

function text(str, x, y, size, color, align = 'center', weight = '700') {
  ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.textAlign = align;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(str, x, y);
}

function glowText(str, x, y, size, color, glow) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 22 * sx;
  text(str, x, y, size, color, 'center', '900');
  ctx.restore();
}

function blinkText(str, y, size, t) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 5);
  text(str, W / 2, y, size, '#ffffff', 'center', '800');
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function heartPath(cx, cy, size) {
  const s = size / 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + s * 0.85);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - s * 1.25, cy + s * 0.05, cx - s * 0.95, cy - s * 1.05, cx, cy - s * 0.4);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + s * 0.95, cy - s * 1.05, cx + s * 1.25, cy + s * 0.05, cx, cy + s * 0.85);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function draw(t) {
  ctx.setTransform(sx, 0, 0, sy, 0, 0);
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (const s of stars) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 1.3 + s.p);
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 24, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 24);
  drawBricks();
  drawPaddle();
  if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing' || state === 'paused') drawBall();
  ctx.restore();

  drawOverlay(t);
  drawEffects();
  drawHUD();
  drawToast();
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of bricks) {
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
    if (b.hits >= 2) {
      // Armoured bricks: gold (3 hits left) and steel (2 hits left), one pip per hit.
      ctx.fillStyle = b.hits >= 3 ? '#f2c14e' : '#b8c4dc';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = b.hits >= 3 ? '#9c6f12' : '#5f6c8a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 2);
    if (b.hits >= 2) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 24, 48, 0.6)';
      for (let i = 0; i < b.hits; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(b.x + b.w / 2 + (i - (b.hits - 1) / 2) * 10, b.y + b.h / 2 + 1, 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    if (b.flash > 0) {
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${b.flash * 0.7})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const p = paddle;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, p.y, 0, p.y + p.h);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#a5ecff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#2f7bff');
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80, 190, 255, 0.85)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 16 * sx;
  roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h, p.h / 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)';
  ctx.fillRect(p.x + 10, p.y + 3, p.w - 20, 2);
}

function drawBall() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd8ff';
  for (let i = 0; i < trail.length; i++) {
    const k = (i + 1) / trail.length;
    ctx.globalAlpha = k * 0.3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(trail[i].x, trail[i].y, ball.r * (0.4 + 0.6 * k), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(160, 220, 255, 0.95)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14 * sx;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEffects() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, (p.life / p.maxLife) * 1.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.font = `800 16px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (const f of floaters) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, f.life * 2);
    ctx.strokeText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function hudItem(label, value, x, align) {
  const cy = HUD_H / 2 + 1;
  ctx.font = `700 12px ${FONT}`;
  const lw = ctx.measureText(label).width;
  ctx.font = `800 22px ${FONT}`;
  const total = lw + 8 + ctx.measureText(value).width;
  const x0 = align === 'left' ? x : x - total / 2;
  text(label, x0, cy, 12, '#7f8fc9', 'left', '700');
  text(value, x0 + lw + 8, cy, 22, '#ffffff', 'left', '800');
}

function drawHUD() {
  const cy = HUD_H / 2 + 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0f2b';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#26347a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, 2);

  hudItem('SCORE', String(score), 18, 'left');
  hudItem('LEVEL', `${level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, 'center');

  const size = 18, gap = 6;
  const left = W - 92 - (MAX_LIVES * size + (MAX_LIVES - 1) * gap);
  text('LIVES', left - 10, cy, 12, '#7f8fc9', 'right', '700');
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_LIVES; i++) {
    heartPath(left + i * (size + gap) + size / 2, cy, size);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? '#ff4d6d' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13)';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  drawButton(BTN_SOUND, 'sound');
  if (pauseAvailable()) drawButton(BTN_PAUSE, 'pause');
}

function drawButton(r, kind) {
  const x = r.x, y = r.y;
  roundRect(x, y, r.w, r.h, 7);
  ctx.fillStyle = hoverBtn === kind ? '#2a3a80' : '#161f4a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#34458f';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#dfe6ff';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#dfe6ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  if (kind === 'pause') {
    if (state === 'paused') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + 10, y + 7);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 21, y + 14);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 21);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 8, 4, 12);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 15, y + 8, 4, 12);
    }
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 6, y + 11);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 11);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 15, y + 7);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 15, y + 21);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 17);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y + 17);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (muted) {
      ctx.moveTo(x + 18, y + 11); ctx.lineTo(x + 23, y + 17);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 23, y + 11); ctx.lineTo(x + 18, y + 17);
    } else {
      ctx.arc(x + 15, y + 14, 4, -0.9, 0.9);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 15 + 8 * Math.cos(-0.9), y + 14 + 8 * Math.sin(-0.9));
      ctx.arc(x + 15, y + 14, 8, -0.9, 0.9);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
}

function dim(alpha) {
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(4, 6, 20, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.fillRect(0, TOP, W, H - TOP);
}

function panel(x, y, w, h) {
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(18, 26, 66, 0.85)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#33438a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawOverlay(t) {
  if (state === 'title') {
    dim(0.8);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - 260, 0, W / 2 + 260, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#ff5c7a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffd84d');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#4cc9f0');
    glowText('BRICK BREAKER', W / 2, 140, 64, g, 'rgba(255, 160, 90, 0.55)');
    text(`Clear ${LEVELS.length} levels of bricks. You have ${MAX_LIVES} lives.`, W / 2, 196, 18, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    panel(150, 230, 500, 155);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#33438a';
    ctx.fillRect(400, 248, 1, 88);
    text('MOUSE', 275, 260, 13, '#7f8fc9');
    text('Move to steer the paddle', 275, 292, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Click to launch the ball', 275, 320, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('KEYBOARD', 525, 260, 13, '#7f8fc9');
    text('← →  or  A / D  to steer', 525, 292, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Space to launch the ball', 525, 320, 16, '#ffffff', 'center', '500');
    text('Pause: P / Esc     ·     Sound: M', W / 2, 360, 14, '#9aa6d6', 'center', '500');
    blinkText('Click or press Space to start', 440, 24, t);
    if (best > 0) text(`Best score: ${best}`, W / 2, 488, 16, '#ffd84d', 'center', '600');
  } else if (state === 'serve') {
    if (levelIntro) {
      glowText(`LEVEL ${level + 1}`, W / 2, 380, 44, '#ffffff', 'rgba(90, 160, 255, 0.9)');
    } else if (ballLost) {
      const msg = lives === 1 ? 'Ball lost — last life!' : `Ball lost — ${lives} lives left`;
      text(msg, W / 2, 380, 22, '#ff8a9e', 'center', '700');
    }
    blinkText('Click or press Space to launch', 435, 20, t);
  } else if (state === 'paused') {
    dim(0.65);
    glowText('PAUSED', W / 2, 260, 56, '#ffffff', 'rgba(90, 160, 255, 0.9)');
    text('Press P / Esc or click to resume', W / 2, 320, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
  } else if (state === 'levelclear') {
    dim(0.6);
    glowText(`LEVEL ${level + 1} CLEAR!`, W / 2, 250, 52, '#5ee38b', 'rgba(94, 227, 139, 0.7)');
    text(`+${LEVEL_BONUS} bonus`, W / 2, 305, 22, '#ffd84d', 'center', '700');
    text(`Get ready for level ${level + 2}`, W / 2, 345, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    if (stateTime > 0.6) blinkText('Click or press Space to continue', 420, 18, t);
  } else if (state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') {
    dim(0.78);
    if (state === 'win') {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 180, 0, 240);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#fff3b0');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#f2b233');
      glowText('YOU WIN!', W / 2, 210, 68, g, 'rgba(255, 216, 77, 0.7)');
      text('Both levels cleared!', W / 2, 262, 20, '#c9d3ff', 'center', '500');
    } else {
      glowText('GAME OVER', W / 2, 220, 64, '#ff5c7a', 'rgba(255, 92, 122, 0.7)');
    }
    text(`Score: ${score}`, W / 2, 310, 30, '#ffffff', 'center', '800');
    text(newBest ? 'New best score!' : `Best: ${best}`, W / 2, 350, 18, newBest ? '#ffd84d' : '#9aa6d6', 'center', '600');
    if (stateTime > 1) blinkText('Click or press Space to play again', 430, 22, t);
  }
}

function drawToast() {
  if (toastTime <= 0) return;
  ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, toastTime * 3);
  ctx.font = `700 15px ${FONT}`;
  const w = ctx.measureText(toastText).width + 28;
  roundRect(W / 2 - w / 2, TOP + 6, w, 26, 13);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 14, 40, 0.85)';
  ctx.fill();
  text(toastText, W / 2, TOP + 19, 15, '#ffffff', 'center', '700');
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ===== Sound (generated with Web Audio, no files needed) ====================
let audioCtx = null, muted = false;

// Browsers only allow audio after a user gesture, so this runs on key/pointer input.
function initAudio() {
  if (!audioCtx) {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return;
    try { audioCtx = new AC(); } catch (err) { return; }
  }
  if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
    const p = audioCtx.resume();
    if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {});
  }
}

function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo = 0, delay = 0) {
  if (muted || !audioCtx || audioCtx.state !== 'running') return;
  const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime + delay;
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
  if (slideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, t0 + dur);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  osc.start(t0);
  osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
}

function melody(notes, step, dur, type, vol) {
  notes.forEach((f, i) => tone(f, dur, type, vol, 0, i * step));
}

const sfx = {
  wall: () => tone(240, 0.04, 'square', 0.025),
  paddle: () => tone(420, 0.07, 'square', 0.045, 520),
  brick: (y) => tone(Math.max(300, 980 - y * 1.6), 0.08, 'square', 0.04),
  tough: () => tone(170, 0.08, 'sawtooth', 0.04, 120),
  launch: () => tone(520, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.08, 880),
  lose: () => tone(330, 0.45, 'sawtooth', 0.05, 70),
  pause: () => tone(600, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.06),
  start: () => melody([523, 784], 0.08, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.08),
  levelClear: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047], 0.11, 0.16, 'square', 0.04),
  gameOver: () => melody([392, 330, 262, 196], 0.2, 0.28, 'triangle', 0.09),
  win: () => melody([523, 659, 784, 1047, 784, 1047], 0.12, 0.18, 'square', 0.04),
};

function toggleMute() {
  muted = !muted;
  showToast(muted ? 'Sound off' : 'Sound on');
}

// ===== Input ================================================================
const keys = { left: false, right: false };
let pointerX = W / 2;          // pointer x in playfield units
let pointerHover = null;       // last pointer position, for button hover / cursor
let pointerActive = false;     // true while the mouse (or touch) steers the paddle
let lastClientX = null, lastClientY = null;
let hoverBtn = null;

function toLogical(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width),
    y: (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height),
  };
}

function inRect(p, r) {
  return p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y <= r.y + r.h;
}

function pauseAvailable() {
  return state === 'serve' || state === 'playing' || state === 'paused';
}

function buttonAt(p) {
  if (inRect(p, BTN_SOUND)) return 'sound';
  if (pauseAvailable() && inRect(p, BTN_PAUSE)) return 'pause';
  return null;
}

// Hide the cursor over the playfield while playing; show a hand over HUD buttons.
function updateCursor() {
  hoverBtn = pointerHover ? buttonAt(pointerHover) : null;
  let cursor = 'default';
  if (hoverBtn) cursor = 'pointer';
  else if ((state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') && pointerHover && pointerHover.y > TOP) cursor = 'none';
  if (canvas.style.cursor !== cursor) canvas.style.cursor = cursor;
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
  initAudio();
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'ArrowLeft':
    case 'KeyA':
      keys.left = true;
      pointerActive = false;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case 'ArrowRight':
    case 'KeyD':
      keys.right = true;
      pointerActive = false;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case 'Space':
    case 'Enter':
    case 'NumpadEnter':
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!e.repeat) primaryAction();
      break;
    case 'KeyP':
    case 'Escape':
      if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
      break;
    case 'KeyM':
      if (!e.repeat) toggleMute();
      break;
  }
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = false;
  if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = false;
});

window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
  keys.left = keys.right = false;
  if (state === 'playing') togglePause();
});

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if (document.hidden && state === 'playing') togglePause();
});

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
  const p = toLogical(e);
  pointerHover = p;
  // Browsers sometimes fire moves without motion; ignore those so the keyboard keeps control.
  if (e.clientX !== lastClientX || e.clientY !== lastClientY) {
    lastClientX = e.clientX;
    lastClientY = e.clientY;
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerActive = true;
  }
  updateCursor();
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
  initAudio();
  const p = toLogical(e);
  pointerHover = p;
  const btn = buttonAt(p);
  if (btn === 'sound') toggleMute();
  else if (btn === 'pause') togglePause();
  else {
    lastClientX = e.clientX;
    lastClientY = e.clientY;
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerActive = true;
    primaryAction();
  }
  updateCursor();
});

// Touch input only unlocks audio on pointerup, so try again there.
window.addEventListener('pointerup', initAudio);
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());

// ===== Main loop ============================================================
let lastTime = -1;

function frame(now) {
  const dt = lastTime >= 0 ? Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastTime) / 1000)) : 0;
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  draw(now / 1000);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

loadLevel(0);
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
